super6.comment: Dartmouth gelding. Half-brother to 3 winners, including fairly useful hurdler Abbey Scope (21f-23f winner) and modest chaser Holme Abbey (2½m winner), stayed 2¾m. Dam ran once in bumper. Yard going well and he could be in the mix on debut.
Showed ability in a couple of maiden hurdles in Ireland for different yards and type to do better in handicaps.

finals.race: Margaret Long Memorial Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Looked a good prospect when winning an Ayr bumper on debut and made a promising start over hurdles when second in 11-runner maiden at Kelso (2m) in December last year. Off a further 10 months since but he returns with his yard amongst the winners. Strong contender.

finals.race: Margaret Long Memorial Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: €17,000 3-y-o, Walk In The Park gelding. Half-brother to useful hurdler/smart chaser Ornua (2m-21f winner) and poor chaser Bignorm (23f winner), stayed 3¼m. Made the frame on first start in Irish points but failed to complete both subsequent outings. Wears hood for Rules debut.

finals.race: Conference & Banqueting Facilities At Limerick Racecourse Maiden Hurdle
finals.comment: Fair form when fifth in maiden at Wexford (2½m, soft) on hurdling bow in April. Last of 14 in novice at Kilbeggan (2m, good) following month but back on track to an extent at Limerick last month. Will need longer trips ultimately but headgear may help him travel with a bit more purpose.

finals.race: Conference & Banqueting Facilities At Limerick Racecourse Maiden Hurdle

finals.comment: Dartmouth gelding. Half-brother to 3 winners, including fairly useful hurdler Abbey Scope (21f-23f winner) and modest chaser Holme Abbey (2½m winner), stayed 2¾m. Dam ran once in bumper. Yard going well and he could be in the mix on debut.

Showed little in a pair of Down Royal bumpers for Paul Traymor last season but has shown fair form at up to 1¾m on the Flat subsequently, including for current yard. Has place prospects if taking to this new discipline.

Resumed progress on fourth start for this yard when making all in good style at Kelso when last seen in February. Makes a belated return to hurdles (dual winner) but he's potentially very well treated in this sphere.
Showed ability in a couple of maiden hurdles in Ireland for different yards and type to do better in handicaps.

Offered plenty to work on when second of 15 in bumper at Bellewstown on debut for Stuart Crawford in April. Ran to a similar level tackling appreciably more testing ground when third at Galway recently and sets the standard.

finals.race: ARC All-Weather Bonus Is Back Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Showcasing filly who saw off a next-time-out winner on her debut at Leicester (6f, heavy) 3 weeks ago. From a talented family connections know well and surely more to come.
